contractsBuilder.note: Produces a genuinely real MidgardValidators bundle (every hub/control field built from the current blueprint via loadRealBlueprint(), not the AlwaysSucceeds test stand-in) from a one-shot outref UTxO plus a reference-script auth policy.

measurement.method: For every roster target: select funding UTxOs (selectReferenceScriptFundingUtxos), build a single-target reference-script publication transaction via completeReferenceScriptPublicationTxProgram (the same builder demo/midgard-node's production reference-script publication path calls), sign it with the wallet, measure the complete signed CBOR (byte length, fee) against PROTOCOL_PARAMETERS_DEFAULT.maxTxSize (16,384), then submit and await confirmation on a Lucid Emulator constructed with maxTxSize explicitly pinned to that real 16,384-byte L1 limit (not the emulator's relaxed default), and confirm exactly one live reference-script UTxO exists at the expected output index. Targets are processed sequentially so each publication's funding selection sees the prior one's confirmed wallet UTxOs.
measurement.driver: demo/midgard-node/tests/scratch-cg1-publication-fit.test.ts, a committed driver. The original 2026-08-18 run used a throwaway scratch file of the same name that was deleted afterwards, so this artifact's own reproductionCommand named a path that did not exist. The driver was re-derived from this artifact's roster, hashBasis and method fields and committed, so CG1 is re-measurable after any blueprint regeneration. It pins nothing: the roster comes from nodeRuntimeReferenceScriptTargets, the contracts from loadRealMidgardContractsForTest against the working-tree blueprint, and every hash, byte count and fee is measured. MIDGARD_CG1_EMIT=<path> writes the measured roster in this artifact's own shape.

remeasured.issue: #623 (owner ruling 2026-08-22: re-measure once, against the post-#617-wave regenerated blueprint)
remeasured.method: The exclusion target was published through exactly this artifact's own method: the real contracts bundle from loadRealMidgardContractsForTest at this artifact's fixed all-zero one-shot outref, the applied CEK direct resolver taken as buildFaultProofContracts(...).validationTraceDispute.prepareResolvers[11] at the deployment's own hubOracle / fraudProofCatalogue policy ids, published through completeReferenceScriptPublicationTxProgram, signed, measured as complete signed CBOR, then submitted and confirmed on a Lucid Emulator whose maxTxSize is pinned to the real 16,384-byte L1 limit. The driver was a transient lane-N file, deliberately not committed: committing it would add a second publication-fit driver alongside tests/scratch-cg1-publication-fit.test.ts for a role that is not in the roster, and whether the role joins the roster is the open question below, not this measurement's to decide.
remeasured.submitted: Accepted and confirmed by the emulator at maxTxSize 16,384; exactly one live reference-script UTxO at output index 1.
remeasured.versusPinnedExclusion: The pinned exclusion records appliedScriptHash a4bfbd01..., 162,145 applied bytes, 162,660 signed bytes and an L1 margin of -146,276. Re-measured against the regenerated blueprint the same role is 5,471 applied bytes, 5,984 signed bytes and an L1 margin of +10,400 -- it fits the publication envelope with 10,400 bytes to spare, and does so by real submission rather than by arithmetic.
remeasured.decisionNotTakenHere: exclusions[0] is left exactly as pinned. This gate requires its single exclusion to measure above 16,384 bytes, so replacing the triple with the measured one would make the exclusion self-contradictory; and the consequence of the role fitting is that it belongs in nodeRuntimeReferenceScriptTargets -- a runtime roster plus deployment-manifest movement, with the same numbers restated in the owner-signed cek-program-material necessity document and in the GOAL_PROGRESS.md ledger quote ('162,660 signed bytes, L1 margin -146,276'), both owner-owned surfaces. Per #623's ruling the executing lane brings the measured basis to the owner rather than editing them. Measurement delivered; the exclusion decision is the owner's.
remeasured.rosterReproduction: The 34 roster rows above were re-measured in the same pass (pnpm --dir demo/midgard-node exec vitest run tests/scratch-cg1-publication-fit.test.ts, MIDGARD_CG1_EMIT set) and reproduced byte-for-byte: every appliedScriptHash, serializedScriptBytes, completeSignedTransactionBytes, l1ByteMarginBytes and feeLovelace is identical to the pinned row. The only per-run difference is txHash, which the gate does not read and which the emulator derives from run-specific wallet seeds; the roster's fit claims are therefore reproducible and its transaction hashes are not.
